# GradTensor

> An applied AI specialist firm: training, consulting, and our own product.

GradTensor is an applied AI specialist firm. We train your people, decide with you where AI belongs using our own method, the Judgment Line, and build the systems on our own product, Forge. We work with owner-led and mid-size businesses across industries, wherever there is real operational complexity and little in-house AI, and with colleges and training providers. Based in India, founded as a venture of Sudhanva Labs LLP.

## What we do

Three ways to work with us. Most engagements use more than one.

### 01 AI training (service)
- Hands-on programmes taught on your own workflows, so people leave able to do the work differently
- Corporates: role-based upskilling for teams and leadership, with a usage policy people can follow
- Colleges: job-ready AI skills for students and faculty
- Industry verticals: programmes shaped to the way your sector actually works

### 02 AI consulting (service)
- Assess: map your operations and draw the Judgment Line, workflow by workflow, between what AI should run, what it should assist, and what stays with your people
- Build: assistants, trackers, and automations that run on your real work, with a human on the decisions that matter
- Govern: review what the systems did, tune the thresholds, handle the exceptions, and redraw the line as your business changes

### 03 Forge (product)
- Our own product, and where our engagements get built
- A private AI workspace for confidential work: your people work with your documents and data in plain language, inside a workspace your organisation controls
- Product site: https://www.forgeprivate.com

## The Judgment Line (our method)

Where AI goes. The line, drawn workflow by workflow, between what AI carries and what stays with your people. Final quality sign-off, contractual and pricing commitments, safety-critical and compliance decisions, and final verification never cross it. Drawn before anything is built, and redrawn as the business changes.

## Defensible AI (our standard)

What AI has to prove once it is there. Three properties, in this order:

- Reliable: dependable, reproducible answers you can stand behind
- Accountable: answers can be traced, evaluated, and explained, so you know who is answerable for them
- Confidential: sensitive information stays within the boundaries it is permitted to exist in

## Forge, in detail

- Answers can be traced back to the material they came from
- Access controls, audit logs, and retention you set, with permanent deletion when you want it
- Nothing you send trains a model
- A sealed environment for delivering a proprietary model to a client: they upload their data and get the analysis back, and never see the code
- Forge is hosted software. It is not self-hosted or deployed on a customer's own servers, and it does not claim in-country data residency.
- Any organisation can use Forge on its own; in a GradTensor engagement we deploy and govern it for you, end to end, on your real work
